overview: The Medford Community Preservation Committee met to review FY27 CPA funding applications for historic preservation, open space, and recreation projects across the city. The committee heard presentations from project proponents and addressed small grant requests and procedural business.

items.title: Shiloh Baptist Church Stained Glass Window Restoration
items.summary: Representatives from Shiloh Baptist Church presented an application requesting $225,000 in CPA funds to restore historic stained-glass windows, with committee members requesting additional vendor estimates and baseline survey documentation before a vote.

items.title: DPW Victory Park Courts and Tree Planting Proposals
items.summary: Department of Public Works Director Tim McGivern presented proposals for $264,000 to resurface tennis and basketball courts at Victory Park and $75,000 to plant approximately 100 trees in public parks.

items.title: Barry Park Playground Redesign Proposal
items.summary: Parks and Open Space Planner Amanda Centrella presented a $134,000 funding request to design an accessible playground overhaul and evaluate green stormwater infrastructure at Barry Park.

items.title: Medford Public Schools Playground and Curtis Tufts Preservation Studies
items.summary: Chief Operations Officer Ken Lord presented applications requesting $250,000 to design accessible playgrounds at three elementary schools and $40,000 for an architectural design study to restore the historic Curtis Tufts School building.

items.title: Unitarian Universalist Church Rectory Roof Small Grant Application
items.summary: The committee reviewed an urgent small grant application for $17,640 to repair a leaking slate roof on the Unitarian Universalist Church rectory, requesting the applicant clarify the long-term scope and repair approach prior to a vote.

items.title: Recreation Department Condon Shell Lighting Fund Transfer Request
items.summary: The committee considered a request to transfer $50,000 from the Tufts Park lighting grant to cover a bid shortfall for Condon Shell lighting, advising staff that the department must formally request a grant reduction and submit an off-cycle application instead.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The committee voted to approve the meeting minutes for September 8, 2026, and October 13, 2026.
